ops.title: grade-first-pools handoff 1: why grade first does not make the pools grade
ops.body:
Lane grade-first-pools (drive durable-agents-rebuild), brief /Users/yasyf/.vcache/scratch/meta-desk-3/b/grade-first-pools.md. Parent team-lead (meta-desk-3).

Worktree: /Users/yasyf/repos/claude/worktrees/cc-skills/grade-first-pools (git, branch grade-first-pools, from origin/main 9c87f3191985). No edits yet.

## Gap, read from code and store (lr.sqlite at /Users/yasyf/.claude/scratch/durable-agents-rebuild)

`lr grade first N` posts kind `lr.first` "first: #N". JobPool.Rank (rank.go) reads lr.first plus root decide/ask in the last 3 h into p.firsts and sorts the items first. grading.Act (grading.go) only dispatches open store items of kind `grade` whose snapshot head matches, that are not Held(), and whose head still owes a grade (Missing). It also skips a grader whose pass at base `<pr>-<head12>` settled (ErrAnswered), and finderJob/fidelityJob return ErrAnswered on a head that already carries their grade. So a first only reorders heads that already owe a grade and have a grade item.

None of the five had one when put first:
- #51676 a28d3f5: finder ok, fidelity missing at 5:33 PM; open item `verdict` 27243. Lane asked a fidelity regrade (7488@0138104e); root answered with first (521349/521350, 7:09 PM) and again at 8:12 PM (523811). Missing empty, so no-op.
- #51669 5fd6f66: finder major (515432), fidelity ok; item `verdict` 27161. Root owed a finder regrade after refutation 2908, answered with first (521142, 7:05 PM; again 522802).
- #51513 bd24fbf: finder major, fidelity missing; item `verdict` 27113. first 7:24 PM, 7:46 PM.
- #50212 bcf3c24: finder ask (override withdrawn 12:10 UTC), fidelity ok; item `verdict` 23266. first 6:59 PM; the lane rebased at 8:03 PM (f51c552) and that pass carried "settled by coordinator #430420".
- #51292 2153cb1: finder missing, fidelity ok; item `lift` 26884, held by lane hold 491697 ("Holding 51292 for his card", dashboard-serve-flake-1). Root's lift 520690 resolved ask 520534, not hold 491697, so the hold stays open; Act skips Held(). first 8:01 PM (523330). `lr grade queue finder` still lists it second because owedItems synthesizes rows the pool never gets.

## Fix direction (in progress)
A PR named first gets one pass per grader at its current head on the next pool pass, whatever item is open and held or not: a grader the head is missing goes through its normal base; a grader the head already graded before the first record gets one regrade keyed by that first record (fidelity: the existing regrading path; finder: same-head pass, bypassing its graded-head ErrAnswered). Test replays #51676 or #51292 records: the first PR dispatches before older queued grade items.

Ship: open-pr express, merge `ccx vcs merge <n> -R yasyf/cc-skills --admin --match-head-commit <sha>` once checks finish. Report `cci post --kind landed --to meta-desk,install-desk,owner-relay`, then SendMessage team-lead.
